Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files and displays a ransom screen requiring the victim to read two articles before providing a free decryption key
Deletes encrypted files if the victim does not comply before countdown reaches zero
Connects to Command & Control server to retrieve decryption key after compliance
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom screen similar to Jigsaw Ransomware
References to articles: Google Security Blog 'Stay safe while browsing' and BleepingComputer's 'Jigsaw Ransomware Decrypted: Will delete your files until you pay the Ransom'
Message box labeled 'Nice Jigsaw' displaying decryption key
